picks.name: Romare
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Oblivion" (September 18, 2026) is his fifth album -- 13 tracks of sample-led downtempo, broken beats and house grooves on his own All You See imprint, directing his sample craft toward technology, the environment and power.
picks.why_listen: A genre-fluid, era-hopping sample-based record from an artist you already play -- good for a wide range of moods across a set, from downtempo openers to house-grooved peaks.

picks.name: Dorisburg / Human Space Machine
picks.source_note: Dorisburg already in your library (Nous'klaer Audio roster).
picks.bio: Already have Dorisburg in your library. "Se upp i backen / Lore" (September 18, 2026) is a two-track split on Nous'klaer Audio -- Dorisburg serves a sun-drenched tech house groove on the A-side, while Human Space Machine gives the B a polyrhythmic, heady dub-tech cut.
picks.why_listen: A solid two-tracker from a label you already trust -- Dorisburg's side is sunny and direct, the flip is deeper and more polyrhythmic.
